posts.title: AI-generated menus look the same
posts.summary: Homogenized AI food imagery and training-on-AI-output risks are making restaurant menus look uncanny and samey.

posts.title: Crusoe raises $3B at $30B
posts.summary: AI data-center builder Crusoe is said to have raised $3B at a $30B valuation, with Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI among customers.

posts.title: Thinking Machines eyes $1B Accel round
posts.summary: Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines is reportedly discussing a $1B raise at ≥$40B, with Accel said to lead.

posts.title: Abliteration.ai strips model guardrails
posts.summary: Startup Abliteration.ai hosts open-weight models with safety refusals stripped for red-teaming and API use.

posts.title: Meta pays users for Muse Spark prompts
posts.summary: Meta’s Muse Spark “contributor” tier deep-discounts tokens if users share prompts/outputs for training.

posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
posts.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, a computer-use frontier model framed as entering the “AGI era,” rolling out via Daybreak then ChatGPT/API.

posts.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3: frontier, partly gated
posts.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 ships with strong price/performance, but top “max reasoning” scores remain gated pending more safety testing.

posts.title: Meta Voice Transcribe at $0.18/hour
posts.summary: Meta’s streaming STT API bundles 20+ speaker diarization at $0.18/hour and leads Meta’s cited streaming benchmarks.

posts.title: Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 cut cache costs 75%
posts.summary: Anthropic launched Fable/Mythos 5.1 with cache reads cut to $0.25/MTok and new Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

posts.title: OpenClaw 2.0 brings multiplayer AI coding
posts.summary: OpenClaw 2.0 adds shared cloud sessions, a rebuilt browser workspace, and stronger enterprise sandboxing.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra ‘enters the AGI era’
posts.summary: GPT-6 Astra launches with stronger agentic/coding claims and Critical cyber safeguards after the Hugging Face incident.

posts.title: ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude outage
posts.summary: OpenAI, xAI, and Anthropic chatbots hit concurrent outages Thursday; all later recovered.

posts.title: Gmail, Docs, Keep get live voice chat
posts.summary: Google rolls out Gmail/Docs/Keep Live voice modes so users can query and update those apps conversationally.

posts.title: Nvidia PAIR pools home PCs for local AI
posts.summary: Nvidia’s free open-source PAIR links idle home PCs/Macs into a personal AI data center for local LLM/agent inference.

posts.title: Nvidia buying Hugging Face for ~$13B
posts.summary: Nvidia agrees to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B while pledging the hub stays multi-vendor/open.

posts.title: Claude Code 2.1.260
posts.summary: Adds a live `/diff` panel and fixes a permission-rule bug that left “read-only” folders writable.

posts.title: LLaDA-Image (6B open image gen)
posts.summary: Ant Group’s inclusionAI open-weights 6B image gen/edit model, with a 4-step Turbo checkpoint.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra release tracker
posts.summary: OpenAI’s frontier computer-use model begins Daybreak rollout; Critical cyber rating noted.

posts.title: K2 Horizon: six open models to 375B
posts.summary: IFM releases six Apache-2.0 models (0.9B–375B) with weights, training code, data mixtures, and eval logs.

posts.title: NVIDIA ↔ Hugging Face deal (tracker)
posts.summary: $12.93B acquisition; hub stays multi-vendor; close targeted H1 2027.
